Scope or index integrity drift is non-waivable. Only descriptor validation, nonzero exit, or timeout may reach the explicit literal-user waiver route, whose override is recorded in the enrollment receipt.

Enrollment readiness documentation, command output, and contract tests consistently describe frozen-index rehearsal, setup and execution timeout coverage, close-settled cancellation, non-waivable integrity and cancellation failures, and the single explicit literal-user waiver route across source and packaged artifacts.
The complete Pi extension graph passes strict TypeScript checking and the full repository test suite passes with no regressions under the frozen-index production rehearsal.
